purpose: Author visual and causal-state review of eight Volume IV mechanism scenes in the actual final clean chapter build. This report supplies evidence; it is not an acceptance overlay.
reviewer_type: Simulated author, maintainer, and learner-perspective inspection with automated browser assertions.

build.schema_validation: All eight lessons passed strict shared validator.

coverage.inspection_method: Every endpoint and motion PNG was inspected in native-resolution scene contact sheets, supplemented with full-size frames for dense ownership, rounded coordinates, and the frame final-state badge repair. Contacts crop repeated header/caption material but preserve the scene, values, and causal result.
coverage.motion_sampling: One nontrivial transition per lesson in every profile, requested at 400 ms of its 900 ms illustrative duration; actual paused animation times are recorded per PNG. All authored endpoints are inspected separately.

primitive_grouping.group: Plot and number-line state preservation / endpoint geometry
primitive_grouping.reason: Repeated chart primitives use the shared endpoint-preserving visual transition; no unmodeled physical interpolation is inferred.
Resident values and epochs persist while a pending write is indicated, then commit at the authored endpoint.
The sampled conversion/deadline actions retain prior allocation and task state until completion; obligations remain legible.

shared_controls.scope: Shared keyboard, atomic stepping, lifecycle, reduced-motion, dialog, and cancellation evidence is referenced rather than claimed as a full per-lesson replay here. Its own source/preview limitations remain applicable. This report independently checks final emitted endpoints and representative paused in-flight states.

findings.detail: Plot axis titles, series legends, and marker keys occupy distinct rows; displayed floating values fit cells and carry approximation symbols when rounded.
Ray occupancy uses an explicit visible F/O/? key; phone cells preserve legible identity and evidence epochs.
Frame scene uses equal distance-per-pixel axes; all four final-state marker badges have distinct lanes, including badges 1 and 4.
Short lane tasks use compact T identifiers with a full visible task key, preserving brake-onset identity and state without fragmented labels.

Some temporary auxiliary Update badges wrap on narrow matrix/pool targets during writes. The source occupancy, unchanged neighboring cells, retained epoch, and outstanding ownership remain visible; the badges disappear at the correct complete endpoint.

limitations: Review binds this exact emitted JavaScript, stylesheet, bundle, author data, source, HTML, and PNG set. It does not authorize a later changed build.
Motion was sampled once per lesson/profile around the middle of one selected transition, not at every time of every action. All states and cases received endpoint inspection.
The focused cases use explicitly labeled toy assumptions, not the running-machine numerical safety budget or a certified physical safety test.
PNG files remain local review artifacts; their basenames and SHA256 values bind the inspection without adding all raster captures to the repository.
Shared controls are supported by the referenced runtime regression report; this per-author states suite is not a new exhaustive control regression.
No real students participated, and no measured learning gain is claimed.
